name: GIF Search
shortDescription: Search and copy GIFs inside BTT Launcher.
description: A native BetterTouchTool Launcher plugin with animated previews, GIPHY GIFs and Clips, Klipy, Finer Gifs Club, favorites, recents, and keyboard navigation.
requirements: BetterTouchTool with Swift Launcher plugin and launcher surface support
Internet connection for online providers and media downloads
Apple Command Line Tools if requested by BetterTouchTool for compilation
installation: Restart BetterTouchTool or wait for its Swift plugin watcher to reload.
Open BTT Launcher, search for GIF Search, and open the result.
limitations: GIPHY and Klipy currently use third-party search endpoints; availability and authorization for third-party use must be reviewed before publication.
Finer Gifs Club requires a search term.
Clipboard media support depends on the destination application.
Provider failures or changes may prevent results from loading.
